correctness.rationale: Every graph in the finite claim has a canonical even polygon plus all legal noncrossing odd-separated diagonals; the unique outer Hamiltonian cycle proves dihedral canonicalization covers all isomorphism classes. Two independent programs use different generators and automorphism tests and reproduce all counts and the unique witness. The infinite theorem follows from an equitable nearest-hub shell partition, exact shell distances and the four-element chord-preserving dihedral stabilizer. Computations confirm but do not replace the general proof; exhaustive classification stops at n=12.
